description: This file provides utility functions for handling JSON data securely, specifically a function to safely create JSON RawMessages from potentially corrupted JSON strings, including validation and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: safeJSONRawMessage
methods.description: Creates a json.RawMessage from a string after validating its JSON correctness, falling back to a safe default and logging warnings if the input is corrupted.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two integers.
